verdict.rationale: Cua's documentation presents it as infrastructure that external agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor connect to and drive, not as a product with its own built-in assistant users hand tasks to. The 'named agent' feature (persistent memory, daemon-fired routines, pause/resume) hosts and orchestrates agents but is not documented as a first-party AI assistant. A 'cua-agent' package appears only in one community report, with no first-party documentation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
